newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank says no decision yet on ADIG fund firm.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank says no decision yet on ADIG fund firm.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Commerzbank AG did not reach a decision on the future of their joint mutual fund subsidiary ADIG in talks on Wednesday, Vereinsbank said on Thursday.
"The questions are so complex that one can't expect a result after one meeting," a Vereinsbank spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
The spokesman said the banks had not yet decided when to meet again and when an outcome could be expected. He declined to disclose details of the talks.
Commerzbank and Vereinsbank each own just under 43 percent of ADIG.

Platow Brief newsletter reported on Monday that ADIG's owners were unhappy with the present ownership structure and said the unit might either be split or taken over fully by Commerzbank or Vereinsbank.

Banking sources have said a full takeover by Vereinsbank of ADIG, Germany's fourth largest investment fund group, would make sense because Vereinsbank was trying to expand its asset management activities.
